description: Concise motion-directed edits for the Frame and Kaido case studies. Camera movement is an eased crop within real recorded interface pixels; all shown UI state, actions and clinical decisions come from source recordings.

motionDirection.Frame: One continuous visual idea: hold the saved Scissor Sweep in its session, ease toward the position index, then resolve on that same cue retrieved from Closed Guard. Movement settles before each meaningful state change; no decorative transition.
motionDirection.Kaido: Move from clinic-level priority into the heel-raise review, gently tighten as 18 becomes 19 while preserving the separate Not yet state, open the qualified finding and sources, then return to the clinician’s saved decision.
motionDirection.reducedMotion: Parallel edits keep the same source actions and editorial order with a static crop; selected from prefers-reduced-motion and respected in the no-JavaScript source fallback.

sources.Kaido: Existing product-stories-20261021/capture recordings and marks; fictional demonstration clinic and patients.
